text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Appointed!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Our annual New Year's "Lucky Trainer Race"!
As the trainer in charge of Katsuragi Ace,
won't you run in it this year?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your everyday passionate attitude is a source of energy for everyone!
Run strong from the start of the new year, and energize the academy!

“—And so, nominated by Chairwoman Akikawa
for the 'Fortune Trainer Race,'
I continued my independent training for victory, but...”
choice_data_list: (I wonder how far I can take this...)

text_block_list.text:
My primary job is, after all, being a Trainer to my Umamusume.
To avoid causing any trouble, I squeezed in running sessions between work,
but there was surprisingly little time...
—Hey, what's with the distance between us?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you keep it a secret from me?!
I heard all about the "Lucky Trainer Race"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: This is to repay you for everything! I'm gonna whip you into shape with some thorough training!
(Slither... slither...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it feels kind of surreal.
Pulling tires together with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—That's it, put your hips into it more.
Step forward and crouch down just a bit, like that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! Let's stop running here!
Take a short break. Catch your breath slowly!
Ace has been training diligently on her running these past few days. However, as her Trainer, there was something I couldn't help but wonder about.
choice_data_list: Ace, I need to talk to you...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ? What's up? I ain't listenin' to no whining, ya hear!
choice_data_list: Coaching for this long... isn't it a bother?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Hahaha!
What are you even saying, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I said I was 'paying you back,' right?
It's only for a few days, so don't sweat it!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I don't need 'sorry's!
Instead... you'd better become my 'Trainer of Fortune'!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—I believe in your running!!
So you better believe in yourself too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright...
Back to running before my good luck gets away!

And so arrived the day of the "Lucky Trainer Race."
While waiting nervously amidst the heated excitement of top contenders...
the moment finally came!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, opening the gate!
—On your marks! Ready... Go!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em--!!

"A throng of Trainers sprinting across the shrine grounds.
The lead pack, as expected, consisted entirely of
fired-up veterans who knew the course inside and out."

Slipping around the curve, nearly tumbling.
Missing a step on the stairs, feet threatening to cramp.
With every stumble, the back of the leader drifts further away...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Don't give up-!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up-!!
We're still only at the halfway mark-!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—I believe in your running!!
So you better believe in yourself too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Goooooo――!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your hard work, everyone!
Under the pleasant New Year's sky...
The one who has been led to this year's greatest blessing is this person!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That Trainer was amazing!"
"Even after falling way behind, they pushed through on sheer grit... Talk about an auspicious sign!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!!
No question about it, that was a total blowout!!
choice_data_list: I ran believing in both myself and the ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha!! You never fail to deliver!!
You truly are this year's top... "Lucky Trainer"!!

Running with all my might, I clung desperately to the leader.
We contested it to the very end, throwing ourselves across the line.
And the result is—?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, 2nd place!!
That was a heck of a run, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You just finished running,
and you're already rarin' for more!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In that case, wanna enter next year too?
Next time, let's seize the title of 'Lucky Trainer'!

Running with all our might, we caught up to the leaders...
and tumbled into the shrine grounds in a tight pack!
And the result is—?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
3rd place?! That was definitely 1st just now!
I'm protesting this, protesting—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Still...!
choice_data_list: Next year, let's take 1st place so clearly that no one can doubt it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Haha, sounds great!
Let's win "Fortune Trainer" next time!

I regained my composure and ran with everything I had.
Just when I thought I had the lead pack in my sights—
I fell one step short of placing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, I just wasn't good enough...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, no. I was totally captivated
by that late surge after falling behind!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
To achieve this much in such a short period of time...
...Man, if she runs next year too, she might blow everyone away!
